task.title: L8a.5: GPU cancel ceiling, kill-restart-reload cost, VRAM exhaustion after load, packaged evidence
task.objective: Phase L L8a.5 (awkit-djnl.11). Measure on the real Vulkan host, for every layer and for a partial load: cancel latency against the L1.8 3 s ceiling during prompt processing and during generation, and the cost of a host killed and brought back with the model. Probe how a loaded host behaves while other processes take the adapter's VRAM. Handle a GPU lost after a successful load (the host's inference failed or it exited) as its own reason, LOST_AFTER_LOAD. The first loss frees the GPU and re-plans against the VRAM free by then. At GPU_LOSS_LIMIT the setting stays off the GPU for the session: GPU-Offload runs on CPU & RAM and GPU-Only refuses, until the mode or reserve changes, and the CPU host's restart circuit never sees it. Prove CPU & RAM only again and the GPU paths on a fresh packaged build. No host OOM classifier: the runtime's free-VRAM reading lags other processes (measured), so the cause is not diagnosed. No NVIDIA qualification without a 0x10DE adapter (E11).

security: No new permission, channel or setting; the host protocol and ai-host.cjs are unchanged.
The GPU still starts only through the L8a.2 pack guard before every fork, and E2 still decides eligibility.
offline: Nothing GPU enters the installer; the package is rebuilt only so the signed manifest's source commit matches HEAD for the strict gate.

acceptance.description: A GPU lost after load fails that job, frees the GPU and re-plans; at GPU_LOSS_LIMIT GPU-Offload runs on CPU and GPU-Only refuses, both with LOST_AFTER_LOAD, until the mode or reserve changes; cancels, kills that honour them and CPU host crashes are no loss; each guarantee mutation-tested.
Cancel within the 3 s ceiling in both phases, and the kill-restart-reload cost, for every layer and a partial load on the real Vulkan host; VRAM taken after load observed.
A fresh package passes strict offline validation; CPU & RAM only runs a real inference in the packaged EXE; the GPU modes and lifecycle run on the packaged AI tree.
Typecheck, bundles, script typecheck, regressions and the verifier registry pass.

evidence.command: manual source mutation, verifier run, revert
evidence.observed: 6/6 caught and reverted: loss never counted (172/10), limit never enforced (176/6), live GPU host not released (178/4), CPU crash counted (181/1), cancel-kill counted (181/1), setting key ignored (180/2)
